newsitem.title: GREECE: ALL 15 EU COUNTRIES WILL JOIN EMU BY 2002-DUISENBERG.
newsitem.headline: ALL 15 EU COUNTRIES WILL JOIN EMU BY 2002-DUISENBERG.

text.p: Dutch central bank governor Wim Duisenberg who announced his candidacy for the presidency of the future European Central Bank (ECB) on Tuesday said he expected all 15 countries to join EMU by 2002.
All 15 European Union members will participate in the EMU by 2002, Duinsberg told German business daily Boersen Zeitung.
Greece hopes to join the EMU in the second wave.
Some countries will not be able to meet the budget deficit criteria in 1997, he said.
"But it is not a catastrophe if one, two, three, four countries join a little later," Duisenberg told German Die Welt newspaper today.
